ex.en: For another, they present the project with a funny video because good visuals and a sense of humor improved success.

tip: 英式拼写humour，美式humor；作动词表示迁就。

senses.zh: num.百 百个 百位 n.许多

ex.en: It means saying 'no' to the hundred other good ideas that there are.
Five hundred miles west of Iceland, he and his men reached an icy rocky mass of land.

tip: 具体数词后用hundred；泛指数百用hundreds of。

sourceRows.zh: num.百 百个 百位 n.许多

senses.zh: n.饿 饥饿 渴望 v.饿 渴望 使...饥饿

ex.en: By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems.
"This shows that the relationship between hunger and food intake is more complex than we thought."

tip: 名词通常不可数；渴望某物用hunger for。

sourceRows.zh: n.饿 饥饿 渴望 v.饿 渴望 使...饥饿

senses.zh: adj.饥饿的 渴望的

ex.en: "Breakfast is most important for people who are hungry when they wake up," Johnstone says.
Hungry customers can pay whatever amount they can afford to eat at the cafe or nothing at all.

tip: hungry for后接名词，表示渴望某物。

sourceRows.zh: adj.饥饿的 渴望的
